decisions.evidence: Balancing these features, the molecule is more consistent with a non-mutagenic outcome, so the final prediction is option (A): is not mutagenic.

Taken together, the three positive neighbors and the three negative neighbors all end up leaning toward the non-mutagenic label overall. In every comparison, the query repeatedly shows lower minimum absolute partial charge and lower maximum partial charge, higher fraction of sp3 carbons, and in several cases a lower neutral fraction, with only the strongest basic pKa and, in some neighbors, rotatable-bond count pointing toward mutagenicity. Because the non-mutagenic signals are consistently stronger across all six analogs, the combined evidence supports option (A): is not mutagenic.
